# herdsman transcript-audit

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

Audit a Claude or Codex transcript for writes: transcript-audit claude|codex <transcript> <session-id> [root/ ...].

```text
usage: herdsman transcript-audit claude|codex <transcript> <session-id> [allowed-write-root/ ...]

Audits a transcript for writes: GAP, FLAG and AUDIT lines. --json prints
each line as an Event object. AUDIT_GRANT_FILE names the exact command
lines an administrative grant permits.

exit codes:
  0  clean
  1  flagged calls: report each to the human and stop work
  2  a gap: the transcript could not be audited
```
